content: Melvin-Koushki notes that Jean Aubin assumed Ibn Turka's Shiʿi identity in his 1957 article but later modified his opinion in a 1991 article, a fact Melvin-Koushki credits to Dr. Binbaş.
refers_to_primary: Aubin, ‘Le mécénat timouride à Chiraz’ (1957); ‘De Kûhbanân à Bidar’ (1991) (per MK fn.125)
